title: Short Item Names (SIN)
description: This pack changes some Item Names.
body:
Turns 200 items into more common and short names! Makes your item names smoother and shorter. Changes the long and durpy item names into more shorter, common-ner, and smoother. Here are the item names that got changed. (This pack is designed for 1.21.x but is tested to work up to 26.2.)

⚔️ Combat & Gear, Golden Helmet -> Gold Helmet, Golden Chestplate -> Gold Chestplate, Golden Leggings -> Gold Leggings, Golden Boots -> Gold Boots, Leather Cap -> Leather Helmet, Leather Tunic -> Leather Chestplate, Leather Pants -> Leather Leggings, Leather Boots -> Leather Boots, Golden Horse Armor -> Gold Horse Armor, Golden Nautilus Armor -> Gold Nautilus Armor, Golden Sword -> Gold Sword, Golden Spear -> Gold Spear, Crossbow -> X Bow, Totem of Undying -> Totem, Diamond Helmet -> Dia Helmet, Diamond Chestplate -> Dia Chestplate, Diamond Leggings -> Dia Leggings, Diamond Boots -> Dia Boots, Diamond Sword -> Sword, Diamond Spear -> Dia Spear, Diamond Horse Armor -> Dia Horse Armor, Diamond Nautilus Armor -> Dia Nautilus Armor Netherite Helmet -> Neth Helmet, Netherite Chestplate -> Neth Chestplate, Netherite Leggings -> Neth Leggings, Netherite Boots -> Neth Boots, Netherite Sword -> Neth Sword, Netherite Spear -> Neth Spear, Netherite Horse Armor -> Neth Horse Armor, Netherite Nautilus Armor -> Neth Nautilus Armor,
